outline:
Course Title: Mechanisms and Dynamics of Machinery
Prerequisites: None.
This course introduces the principles followed during the movement of mechanical systems and the transmission of forces among parts. It will cover the linkage systems, cams, gears, pure-rolling systems, sprocket wheels, belts, and roller drive sets.
(Taught in English)
